name: saveStep
description: The coach edits one step of a plan: a live session's title, time (or to book), duration, meeting and recording links and shared summary; a homework's title, due date, brief, hand-in list and resources; a check-in's title, form and send day (a date, or N days after a session or homework, kept in step when that step moves). Checks every field and refuses in a sentence (security: role:staff).
